name: Mirvetuximab Soravtansine (FRalpha-high)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT targeted-ADC option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

biomarkers.note: Folate-receptor-alpha (FRalpha) high expression by validated assay selects platinum-resistant patients for mirvetuximab soravtansine.

premedications.name: Ocular prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Lubricating and corticosteroid eye drops with each cycle plus a vasoconstrictor eye drop before infusion; baseline and periodic ophthalmologic exam for keratopathy.

premedications.name: Infusion-reaction prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Antihistamine, antipyretic and corticosteroid per package insert.

supportiveCare: Ocular toxicity (blurred vision, keratopathy) is characteristic: coordinate eye care and hold/reduce for grade 2-3 changes.
Monitor for peripheral neuropathy, pneumonitis and infusion reactions.
monitoring: ophthalmologic exam at baseline and periodically
visual symptoms and neuropathy each cycle
CBC and liver function before each cycle

drugs.name: Mirvetuximab Soravtansine
drugs.notes: Mirvetuximab soravtansine 6 mg/kg (dosed on adjusted ideal body weight) IV on day 1 every 21 days for FRalpha-high, platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian cancer. Hold/reduce for ocular or other grade 2-3 toxicity per package insert. Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
